text:
Marco Diaz: Ok team — Heads-up: RetailEdge (HW partner) wants a coordinated marketplace listing + joint blog + press snippet for their bundled appliance. Need a short playbook we can hand to them. Timeline: 6wk to go.
Priya Patel: +1 — do we have the landing page template for bundled offers or do we build a new one?
Alice Nguyen: We have a storefront module but it needs extra CTA + feature matrix for hardware bundles. I can prototype a variant by EOD Friday.
Samir Khan: For integration checklist: cert of compatibility, image/AMI, install script, and support contacts. Add KV: packaging SKU and billing mapping.
Jenna Ortiz: From comms side: prefer single co-branded blog + 2 tweet threads + one press quote. Need partner legal ok on quote.
Marco Diaz: Good. I'm drafting a one-pager playbook. Sections: partner assets, landing content, launch cadence, press embargo & quote, support/responder matrix, rollback plan.
Priya Patel: Can you include required image sizes and logo usage rules? RetailEdge sent a brand pack but legal needs an asset agreement.
legal-bot: Reminder: partner asset use requires signed brand license (RetailEdge_BrandLicense_v2). Upload to /legal/partner-assets by next Wednesday.
Alice Nguyen: Quick question — do we host the bundle listing in our marketplace or list RetailEdge as a vendor with their own tile? Impacts CTA behavior and billing flow.
Samir Khan: Prefer vendor tile (retailEdge.vendor) + our wrapper that triggers the reserved capacity SKU. That way metrics map to our Dedicated footprint.
Priya Patel: That means we need two landing variants: "Vendor tile" and "Bundle modal". I'll draft copy for both.
Jenna Ortiz: Press cadence: embargo lift 48hrs after listing goes live. Draft blog due 3 business days before embargo. Need approval from RetailEdge PR. Marco can you own the partner PR sync?
Marco Diaz: I'll schedule a 30m PR sync with RetailEdge for Tue 10am PT. Invite RetailEdge: @emily.retailedge and their PR lead. Jenna please prep the draft outline.
Samir Khan: Ops checklist snippet — include these commands we want verified during dry-run:
```
# verify AMI
ssh ubuntu@10.0.0.5 "cat /etc/redwood-release"
# run quick inference smoke
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"retail-edge-x","input":"test"}'
```
Alice Nguyen: I'll bake the modal UI with a small A/B test flag so we can measure CTA conversion for bundle vs tile.
Priya Patel: Localized landing: RetailEdge sells primarily NA & EU — need FR and DE copy. Can partner provide translations or do we localize?
Marco Diaz: Ask them for translations; fall back to our L10n (charges may apply). Add to playbook as decision point.
Jenna Ortiz: Press quote: short, one-sentence from RetailEdge + one from Redwood. Legal to vet. I can draft sample quote templates.
legal-bot: Action required: RetailEdge must sign NDA addendum for product claims if press includes performance numbers.
Samir Khan: Technical owners — Samir (runtime), Alice (UI), Priya (product copy), Marco (partner ops), Jenna (comm). Let's tag status in the playbook as "RAG" rows.
Marco Diaz: Action items: 1) Marco schedule PR sync (Tue 10am PT) 2) Alice prototype landing variant (Fri EOD) 3) Priya draft copy + translations ask (Wed) 4) Jenna draft blog outline + quotes (Mon) 5) Legal: asset license & NDA addendum chase (Wed).
Priya Patel: I'll add dates to the shared sheet and invite RetailEdge PM. Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/sheets/retailedge-playbook (placeholder).
Alice Nguyen: Quick UX note — include a small tooltip explaining "what bundled Dedicated capacity means". Helps PMs.
Jenna Ortiz: Also planning 1x customer story snippet from their early beta — Marco, can you request a short quote from their pilot lead?
Marco Diaz: Will do. I'll send outreach after the PR sync.
Samir Khan: Final item — integration dry-run window: week of the launch -2. Ops needs a 2hr maintenance window for smoke tests. Will plan.
Marco Diaz: Great, I'll consolidate into a 1-pager playbook and post here. Expect draft by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Priya Patel: LGTM.
Alice Nguyen: Thanks — will start on the prototype.
Jenna Ortiz: I'll loop in comms channel once blog draft is ready.
legal-bot: Note: playbook uploaded to /legal/review when ready will trigger a 72h SLA for review.
Marco Diaz: Uploaded initial playbook draft: https://files.redwood.ai/retailedge/playbook-draft-v1.pdf — please review and comment before 5pm PT tomorrow.
Priya Patel: Commented. Left notes on billing mapping.
Alice Nguyen: Commented on imagery and mobile layout.
Samir Khan: Added an ops checklist row re: rate-limit configs.
Jenna Ortiz: Added PR draft outline. Will iterate.
Marco Diaz: Thanks everyone — closing thread, we'll reconvene after PR sync.
